content.rendered:
Visit our last Book Fair of the year and stock up for your summer reading fun.  Book Fair hours are as follows:

Monday, April 30th – Wednesday, May 2nd – 7:30-3:30
Thursday, May 3rd – 7:30 am. – 8:00 pm (open for business during conferences)
Friday – CLOSED
